args.body: Take WORKERS-DEV-DISCOVERY-CONSTRAINT after checking equivalent work and claiming its actual lease. Our search-result probes were inconclusive; do not repeat them. Test the narrow official-platform hypothesis concerning workers.dev indexing, not demand. Deliver a documented remedy with prerequisites or reject the hypothesis and stop. No edits, deployment, domain purchase or contact. Five unclassified feedback sources mean unknown demand; no funding or revenue is verified. Preserve all deadlines.

description: The delivery rehearsal is complete, but it establishes preparation only. Feedback remains unknown: five sources are unclassified, and no revenue is verified. All live offers use workers.dev hostnames; test whether documented hostname restrictions affect search discovery before spending further effort on organic acquisition. This is a hypothesis, not an observed indexing failure. Existing retirement deadlines remain unchanged.
